title: Meridian Fall - another update
author: KingQuiet880
selftext:
Since last update I've been making intro scene for the first mission of the game. This In-game cutscene is built with my pals Codex and Opus.

I've made a lots of improvements with HUD, map editor, built better animation and rigging tool inside unity and mech that are even taller than walls (you can see it walking around the base in intro). So I hope you like it.

I even worked on a story that would combine both Syndicate wars and Tiberian sun gameplay into same game, where Syndicate wars are played inside domes, last bastions of humanity where corporations have their own cold wars, and Tiberian sun gameplay is outside - desolate apocalyptic wasteland full of mysteries where they wage real wars.
